findings.title: CLI22 fixture selects the preserved lock Runtime, not the manifest Runtime
findings.cause: tests/helpers/runtime.py vendored_runtime_commit() reads runtime.lock.json and use_runtime(vendored_runtime_commit()) archives that commit; the migrated test calls it before starting the daemon. The launcher manifest's f103 Runtime path is therefore not the Runtime used by the body.
findings.control: source-check reports the exact mixed tuple; no fake receipt or retarget was introduced

findings.title: Supported launcher accepts duplicate manifest keys

evidence.private_control: duplicate manifest key reached the fake body with exit 17 and produced a second body-call record
evidence.parser_control: private manifest parser rejects duplicate keys, but p4-d73-pinned-launch.sh does not

findings.cause: The launcher assigns pin[key] on every key=value line without a seen-key guard; last-write-wins can alter an otherwise rendered tuple.
findings.control: malformed manifest is refused before body; duplicate behavior is recorded as a finding
